name: ApolloScape — Open Autonomous Driving Platform
description: High-density multi-sensor autonomous driving dataset and benchmark suite released by Baidu Research and Apollo. Features centimetre-accurate 3D point cloud maps captured with a mobile surveying laser scanner alongside high-resolution stereo video streams recorded across diverse Chinese urban traffic conditions. Provides fine-grained pixel-level video semantic parsing across 28 object classes, 3D car instance bounding models with 6-DoF poses, and lane markings.
